# T-1: Unify stale recovery ownership

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Route every stale test evidence entrypoint through the existing guarded impl-repair transaction authority so ledger, manifest, delta, invalidation, and lifecycle state become current as one owned recovery.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1 and R2 preserve exact ledger continuity and transaction evidence consistency.
- R3 and R4 centralize mutation ownership and expose success only after completion.
- R5 resumes or rejects durable partial states without duplicate effects.
- R6 and R8 preserve existing current, malformed, guarded, and public result behavior.

## Implementation Notes
Refine the existing classes in stale-test-evidence-refresh.js and impl-repair-artifacts.js rather than adding object-literal state protocols or a new owner. Reuse the transition intent/effects authority pattern already exercised by run-rewind-test-evidence. Update gate, final-regression, and acceptance-review call context only as needed to bind exact run/spec/Issue and unchanged material authority. Preserve each entrypoint's result projection and the exact invalid_schema support boundary.

## Test Strategy
Use focused unit fixtures for an existing ledger, current material changes, pending journals, foreign identity, changed authority, and each injected durable boundary. Assert artifact bytes and lifecycle status after failure, then assert one converged ledger append after retry.
